name: constant_paths
kind: install from readings already taken (warp_issue v2, c.u0.first8 by warps per SM): rule and value are declared before the engine is changed; no new GPU data
why: Version 1 installed a two-level value for the h100 uniform first touch (60.25 cycles up to 2 warps on the SM, 129.0 above) and named the 3-warp cell as its test. The cell contradicts the step: the cost follows the number of SMSPs that hold a warp.
data_seen_before_freezing: warp_issue v2 addendum, h100, wait at the load (imc_miss) per first-touch load, mean of the eight loads of c.u0.first8 by warps per SM (warp k sits on SMSP k mod 4): 1 warp 60.25 (version 1), 2 warps 64.6 (62 65 69 67 63 64 63 64), 3 warps 95.0 (88 90 107 93 93 91 107 91), 4 warps 127.0 (114 119 138 135 124 117 138 131), 8 warps 129.0 (version 1 value), 16 warps 122.4 (90 115 126 139 126 122 126 135). Per occupied SMSP, counting at least two: 30.1 / 32.3 / 31.7 / 31.8 / 32.3 / 30.6.
The vector path on h100 and both paths on b300 do not change with the warp count (same addendum): untouched.

rules.C5 replaced: On h100 the uniform first touch of a line costs uniform_first_touch_cycles x max(uniform_first_touch_min_smsps, n) / (SMSPs per SM), n = the number of the SM's SMSPs that hold at least one resident warp when the fill starts. uniform_first_touch_cycles keeps its value 129.0 (all four SMSPs occupied). The fields uniform_first_touch_few_warps_cycles and uniform_few_warps_limit leave the leaf (their engine branch is removed with the other superseded constant code in the refactor commit).
rules.mechanism: Not identified beyond the dependence (a fill seems to be delivered per SMSP, two at a time at least); the field is experimental.

judgement.gates: The seven gates, tree build and validate --strict; changed fixture expectations listed with the rule.
judgement.replay: h100 warp_issue v2 cells c.u0.first8.w2 / .w3 / .w4 / .w16 and v1 cells c.u0.first8 / .w1: sum over the eight loads of the wait at the load within 10 % of hardware (expected from the rule: 64.5 / 96.75 / 129 per load against 64.6 / 95.0 / 127.0; at one warp 64.5 against 60.25). Every b300 cell and every h100 vector cell: cycles per cell equal to the previous replay.
judgement.other device: b300 has no such field; its results must not change (140 + 37 cells, cycles equal).

install: h100 leaf: uniform_first_touch_min_smsps = 2; the two few-warps fields removed.
not_allowed: No full-GPU case decides the rule or the value.

addenda.when: 2026-11-16, install (engine + h100 leaf 972fcffb, residency count corrected in 0c1a3a81; build build-0c1a3a81, seven gates 0; replays sim-y2c2b)
addenda.text: Installed on h100. First implementation counted the SMSPs that had ever held a warp instead of those holding one when the fill starts (found in review, corrected in 0c1a3a81 with a fixture; no small kernel and no full-GPU case changed cycles between the two, 500 / 500 equal on both devices). Replay, sum over the eight loads of the wait at the load, replay / hardware: c.u0.first8 at 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 / 8 / 16 warps per SM 542 / 499 (1.09), 542 / 534 (1.01), 798 / 779 (1.02), 1062 / 1034 (1.03), 1060 / 1085 (0.98), 1070 / 1015 (1.05): all inside the 10 %; 32 warps 1120 / 915 (1.22, as before, not a criterion). b300: v1 cells 70 / 70 equal cycles; v2 cells equal except the two yield cells (issue_rules v2). THE CRITERION `every h100 vector cell: cycles equal` IS NOT MET FOR THREE CELLS and was written carelessly: the frame's own prologue has one uniform load, so c.v0.first8 at 1 / 2 / 3 warps per SM changes by +4 / +4 / -33 cycles through that load; the vector loads' waits are unchanged. Full GPU (full-y2c2b against full-kb3): h100 98 cases change cycles (58 closer to hardware, 40 farther), MAPE 11.07 % -> 11.03 %; b300 unchanged by this install.
